nodes.name: EL NINO JARVIS Cyberpunk.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained synthwave/cyberpunk JARVIS console for the El Nino trading engine, with an embedded knowledge base, snapshot series data, a keyword router, voice I/O (Web Speech + optional local TTS/STT bridge), and a Matrix digital-rain theme.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file HTML app: ~1280 non-empty lines mixing heavy CSS theming, embedded KB/series constants, and vanilla-JS speech synthesis/recognition with a fallback to a localhost TTS/STT bridge at 127.0.0.1:8585.

nodes.name: graph.json
nodes.summary: Offline projection of the dev_graph markdown (193 nodes, 1477 edges) exported by export_graph_json.py and consumed by the index.html explorer and the backend /ask corpus; a rebuildable artifact, never hand-edited.
nodes.languageNotes: Flat JSON with meta/nodes/edges sections; node_count 193, edge_count 1477. Per the JARVIS manual this is a projection of the canonical dev_graph markdown and must be regenerated rather than edited.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Offline dev_graph explorer that renders the graph with Cytoscape.js, talking to the live backend API (/health, /meta, /subgraph, /node, /search) to load, search, and expand the El Nino knowledge graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Vanilla-JS single page; loads Cytoscape from a vendored file with a CDN fallback, and reads the API base from localStorage('JARVIS_API') defaulting to http://localhost:8000.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: Core query router that keyword-matches a user question against snapshot series aliases and the topic knowledge base, returning the best answer with a confidence tier, source label, and related threads; falls back to a no-match message pointing at the unwired LLM uplink.

nodes.name: seriesAnswer
nodes.summary: Formats a natural-language answer for a snapshot economic series, reporting its value, staleness, source, tier (Tier-1 snapshot-blocking vs Tier-2 warn-only), and group from the embedded snapshot data.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Renders the context feed panel for a routed answer: topic, match-confidence and source tags, and clickable related-thread chips that resubmit follow-up queries.

nodes.name: setState
nodes.summary: Drives the reactor-core visual state machine (idle / listen / speak), toggling CSS classes and the status line to reflect whether JARVIS is listening or speaking.

nodes.name: speakWS
nodes.summary: Speaks an answer via the browser Web Speech SpeechSynthesis API, building a synced caption with per-word boundary highlighting and reactor pulses, and wiring start/boundary/end handlers to the reactor state.

nodes.name: speakBridge
nodes.summary: Speaks an answer through the optional local voice bridge by POSTing text to the bridge /tts endpoint and playing the returned audio, falling back to browser synthesis on failure.

nodes.name: startListenWS
nodes.summary: Starts or stops browser SpeechRecognition for voice input, silencing any active speech and switching the reactor and input placeholder into listening mode.

nodes.name: startListenBridge
nodes.summary: Records microphone audio and posts it to the local bridge /stt endpoint for transcription, managing recorder lifecycle and listening-state UI for server-side speech recognition.

nodes.name: addGraph
nodes.summary: Merges a subgraph of nodes and edges into the Cytoscape instance (optionally replacing existing elements), deduplicating by id, assigning per-label colors, and re-running the cose layout.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the explorer: probes the backend /health endpoint to set the live/offline status chip, loads label metadata from /meta to populate the type filter and legend, then paints the whole graph.

nodes.name: showNode
nodes.summary: Fetches a single node from /node/:id and renders its label, name, and all properties into the inspector panel with an inline expand-neighbors action.

nodes.name: doSearch
nodes.summary: Runs a backend /search query for the entered term and renders clickable result rows that inspect and expand the chosen node.
